theme: Cool green escape - Gulmarg's meadows deep green and the gondola running while the plains cross 40C, Sonamarg keeping its glaciers, and the Dal glass at dawn, all planned by locals who track the week's fast-changing weather
season: Mid-summer (19 July 2026). Fast-shifting valley weather - sunny mornings, cool evenings and sudden afternoon showers, with flash-flood and landslide watches in South Kashmir; the Amarnath Yatra is paused from 19 July on a weather advisory. Srinagar wakes cool at dawn and warms by day while much of the plains sits above 40C. Gulmarg's meadows are deep green, Sonamarg keeps its glaciers, gardens are in full bloom and the Dal is glass at first light.
campaign_name: Kashmir mid-July green escape - Gulmarg [INR] - 19 Jul 2026
subject: Gulmarg is green underfoot and the air stays cool
